subject.title: Feature request: optional model override in CommitmentsConfig (mirror active-memory/compaction precedent)

question: Should commitments extraction use an explicitly configured utilityModel, gain its own commitments.model surface, or continue inheriting the primary model?
rationale: The existing utility-model surface reduces configuration growth, but its automatic small-model fallback would alter current behavior if adopted wholesale; choosing the permanent precedence and compatibility contract requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Explicit utility model
options.body: Use an explicitly set agents.list[].utilityModel or agents.defaults.utilityModel for commitments, but retain the owning agent primary when utilityModel is unset or empty.

options.title: Commitments-specific model
options.body: Add commitments.model and optional fallback fields with canonical model parsing, accepting the extra configuration and documentation surface for fully independent routing.

options.title: Keep primary inheritance
options.body: Retain current behavior and address overload through queue or concurrency controls, leaving operators without independent extraction cost routing.

recommendation.title: Explicit utility model
recommendation.body: Use an explicitly set agents.list[].utilityModel or agents.defaults.utilityModel for commitments, but retain the owning agent primary when utilityModel is unset or empty.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice governs core configuration growth, default model-routing semantics, and upgrade compatibility rather than a mechanical commitments-only repair.
